description: This file is an Android Activity named MainActivity that demonstrates runtime permission handling for camera access. It provides UI logic to check, request, and handle the permission result, and initiates a camera preview activity upon permission grant.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that manages runtime permission checks for camera access, provides UI to request permission, and starts CameraPreviewActivity when permission is granted.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the content view, and registers a click listener for the button to show camera preview.

methods.name: onRequestPermissionsResult
methods.description: Handles the result of runtime permission requests; if granted, starts camera; if denied, shows a message.

methods.name: showCameraPreview
methods.description: Checks if camera permission is granted; starts camera preview or requests permission otherwise.

methods.name: requestCameraPermission
methods.description: Requests the camera permission, providing additional rationale via Snackbar if needed.
